import ImbalancedChen.Part3CommonPPairMaskRestoration
import Mathlib.Tactic

def originalVariance (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ :=
  ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
    ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m *
        ‖(d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m‖ ^ 2

/-- K_H squared, but the ORIGINAL P times original principal in the cross term. -/
def hybridRow (d : MediumAtom) (H : ℝ) (p m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ‖keptProgressionRow d H p m‖ ^ 2 -
    2 * ((d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexProgressionRow m *
      star ((d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexPrincipalRow m)).re +
    ‖(d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexPrincipalRow m‖ ^ 2

def hybridVariance (d : MediumAtom) (H : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
    ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m * hybridRow d H p m

theorem originalVariance_sub_hybrid_le_M2
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
      |originalVariance d - hybridVariance d H| ≤
        2 * CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d / H := by
  let G : ℕ → ℕ → Label → Label → ℂ := fun _ _ _ _ => 1

theorem literal_commonP_pair_mask_restoration {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    (G : ℕ → ℕ → Label → Label → ℂ)
    (hG : ∀ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
      ∀ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
      ∀ l ∈ labels d p m, ∀ l' ∈ labels d p m, ‖G p m l l'‖ ≤ 1) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
      (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
        d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m * ‖fullPair d G p m - keptPair d H G p m‖) ≤
      2 * CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d / H := by

theorem centeredRow_sub_truncated_eq_tail
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d)
    (H : ℝ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier) (m : ℕ) :
    (d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m -
      truncatedCenteredRow d H p m = tailRow d H p m := by
def cutoffExponent (B A : ℕ) : ℕ := 131073 + betaLogExponent B + 2 * A

theorem centered_tail_energy_le_log_budget
    {B A : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hkappa : 0 ≤ kappa) (hcap : kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ))) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
      (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
        ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
          d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m *
            ‖(d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m -
              truncatedCenteredRow d
                ((1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ cutoffExponent B A) p m‖ ^ 2) ≤
      m2PolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 / (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ (2 * A) := by

theorem rpow_two_mul_le_pow_two_ceil {L : ℝ} (hL : 1 ≤ L) (A : ℝ) :
    Real.rpow L (2 * A) ≤ L ^ (2 * Nat.ceil A) := by
  have hexponent : 2 * A ≤ ((2 * Nat.ceil A : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Nat.le_ceil A) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
  simpa only [Real.rpow_natCast] using
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hL hexponent

theorem centered_tail_energy_le_real_log_budget
    {B : ℕ} {A sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (_hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hkappa : 0 ≤ kappa) (hcap : kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ))) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
      (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
        ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
          d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m *
            ‖(d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m -
              truncatedCenteredRow d
                ((1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ cutoffExponent B (Nat.ceil A)) p m‖ ^ 2) ≤
      m2PolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 / Real.rpow (1 + Real.log d.scale) (2 * A) := by

theorem constant_pos_and_uniform (B : ℕ) :
    let C_B : ℝ := m2PolylogConstant B
    0 < C_B ∧ ∀ (A : ℝ), 0 ≤ A →
      ∀ (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
        MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d → 0 < sigma → 0 ≤ kappa →
          kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ)) →
        CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
          (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
            ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
              d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m *
                ‖(d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m -
                  truncatedCenteredRow d
                    ((1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ cutoffExponent B (Nat.ceil A)) p m‖ ^ 2) ≤
          C_B * d.scale ^ 2 / Real.rpow (1 + Real.log d.scale) (2 * A) := by

def m2PolylogConstant (B : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  12 * mixedMomentConstant * (2 : ℝ) ^ betaLogExponent B

theorem m2PolylogConstant_pos (B : ℕ) : 0 < m2PolylogConstant B := by
  unfold m2PolylogConstant
  exact mul_pos
    (mul_pos (by norm_num) mixedMomentConstant_pos_and_mixedSum_le.1)
    (pow_pos (by norm_num) _)

theorem MediumAtom.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_polylog
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hkappa : 0 ≤ kappa) (hcap : kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ))) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
      m2PolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 *
        (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ (131073 + betaLogExponent B) := by

def MediumAtom.complexProgressionRow (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels, d.complexFactorGamma l.1 * d.beta l.2 *
    (if (((n * l.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) % (complexFactorModulus l.1 : ℤ) =
      d.residue % (complexFactorModulus l.1 : ℤ)) then 1 else 0)

/-- The full primitive-coprime centre on the same labels and modulus. -/
def MediumAtom.complexPrincipalRow (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels,
    d.complexFactorGamma l.1 * d.beta l.2 *
      (if (n * l.2).Coprime (complexFactorModulus l.1) then 1 else 0) /
        (Nat.totient (complexFactorModulus l.1) : ℂ)

def MediumAtom.complexCenteredRow (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  d.complexProgressionRow n - d.complexPrincipalRow n

def MediumAtom.complexDispersionW (d : MediumAtom) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ S, w n * ‖d.complexProgressionRow n‖ ^ 2

def MediumAtom.complexDispersionV (d : MediumAtom) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ S, w n *
    (d.complexProgressionRow n * star (d.complexPrincipalRow n)).re

def MediumAtom.complexDispersionU (d : MediumAtom) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ S, w n * ‖d.complexPrincipalRow n‖ ^ 2

/-- The complex cross term uses its real part, with the primitive centre
retained. It is not the product of two real surrogate rows. -/
theorem MediumAtom.complex_dispersion_identity (d : MediumAtom)
    (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, w n * ‖d.complexCenteredRow n‖ ^ 2) =
      d.complexDispersionW S w - 2 * d.complexDispersionV S w +
        d.complexDispersionU S w := by
  unfold MediumAtom.complexCenteredRow MediumAtom.complexDispersionW
    MediumAtom.complexDispersionV MediumAtom.complexDispersionU
  simp_rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_sub, starRingEnd_apply]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  ring

theorem MediumAtom.complex_dispersion_nonneg (d : MediumAtom)
    (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n ∈ S, 0 ≤ w n) :
    0 ≤ d.complexDispersionW S w - 2 * d.complexDispersionV S w +
      d.complexDispersionU S w := by
  rw [← MediumAtom.complex_dispersion_identity]

theorem complex_norm_sq_sum_eq_double_star {iota : Type*} (S : Finset iota)
    (f : iota → ℂ) :
    ((‖∑ i ∈ S, f i‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ∑ i ∈ S, ∑ j ∈ S, f i * star (f j) := by
  calc
    _ = (∑ i ∈ S, f i) * star (∑ i ∈ S, f i) := by
      rw [Complex.ofReal_pow]
      exact (Complex.mul_conj' _).symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [star_sum]
      simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_comm

theorem MediumAtom.signedError_norm_sq_le_sharedFirstFactorSmoothRows
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    ‖d.signedError‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ^ 2) *
        (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2) *
          ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
            ∑ m ∈ d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
              d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m *
                ‖(d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m‖ ^ 2 := by
  apply (d.signedError_norm_sq_le_sharedFirstFactorRows hd).trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun p _ ↦ q1Slice_rows_le_commonSmooth d hd.2.1 p)

theorem MediumAtom.sharedFirstFactorSmoothRows_eq_dispersion (d : MediumAtom) :
    (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
      ∑ m ∈ d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
        d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m *
          ‖(d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m‖ ^ 2) =
      ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
        ((d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionW
            d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight -
          2 * (d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionV
            d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight +
          (d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionU
            d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight) := by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p _
  exact MediumAtom.complex_dispersion_identity _ _ _

@[bound]
theorem abs_re_le_norm (z : ℂ) : |z.re| ≤ ‖z‖ := by
  rw [mul_self_le_mul_self_iff (abs_nonneg z.re) (Complex.norm_nonneg _), abs_mul_abs_self,
    norm_mul_self_eq_normSq]
  apply re_sq_le_normSq

lemma normSq_eq_norm_sq (z : ℂ) : normSq z = ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
  simp [norm_def, sq, Real.mul_self_sqrt (normSq_nonneg _)]

theorem normSq_sub (z w : ℂ) : normSq (z - w) = normSq z + normSq w - 2 * (z * conj w).re := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, normSq_add]
  simp only [map_neg, mul_neg, neg_re, normSq_neg]
  ring

definition_audit.outside: Original outsideEnergy occurs once. Its nonnegativity follows from the two actual sums of squares.
definition_audit.carriers: Exact primitiveFirstFactorCarrier and cleaned/transposed commonSmoothCarrier, unchanged; no active subset or multiplicity quotient.
definition_audit.D: originalVariance=sum original psi*norm(P-J)^2; actual complexCenteredRow=P-J on the identical cleaned,q1-sliced,transposed atom.
definition_audit.Dhybrid: hybridVariance=sum original psi*(norm(K_H)^2-2Re(P*star J)+norm(J)^2). P in V remains the ORIGINAL progression row; J in both V and U is the identical ORIGINAL principal.

proof_audit: coeff_sum_split and kept_coeff_sum expand exact ordered(n,r,s) labels and split the same full physical congruence and d4 threshold. Every coefficient and gamma factor stays literal; equality cases go to keep<=H.

coeff_sum_eq_progression uses the PUBLIC TailCutoff centeredRow_sub_truncated_eq_tail. After unfolding centered=P-J and truncated=K-J, linear_combination -ht proves K+tail=P. No private parent lemma or new progression identity is assumed.
pairForm_one_re applies Complex.re to actual complex_norm_sq_sum_eq_double_star, reverses orientation, and simplifies G=1. fullPair and keptPair therefore have real parts norm(P)^2 and norm(K)^2.

row_variance_defect uses native Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq and normSq_sub with the same star principal. Ring cancellation gives norm(P-J)^2-hybridRow=norm(P)^2-norm(K)^2. This is exactly D-Dhybrid=W-W_H after original psi summation.
The main hdiff unfolds both double sums, distributes subtraction and factors the same psi. Sub_re and the exact pair identities identify the difference with sum psi*Re(fullPair-keptPair), G=1.

Triangle inequality for the two real sums, abs_mul, psi>=0, and native Complex.abs_re_le_norm bound the absolute total difference by sum psi*norm(fullPair-keptPair). Eout>=0 permits multiplication without a sign reversal.

The existing literal_commonP_pair_mask_restoration at G identically1 has norm bound exactly1 and gives precisely2*Eout*moment/H. There is no added Q1 ratio, second Eout, principal factor or square of H.

domain_audit.finite_theorem: For every original MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d and every real H>0. No hsigma,hkappa,hcap,SW,retained-variance or spectral estimate is added as a premise.
domain_audit.G: Specialized to1 to identify literal W. A nontrivial pair selector needs its own exact identification before calling it original W.
domain_audit.constant: Exactly2, independent of the atom and H.

retained_variance_check.correct_distinction: Dret=sum psi*norm(K-J)^2=W_H-2V_H+U, whereas Dhybrid=W_H-2V+U with original V. Dhybrid-Dret=-2*sum psi*Re(tail*star J).
retained_variance_check.nonnegativity: D is nonnegative. No nonnegativity of Dhybrid is proved or used; the source explicitly says it may be signed.
retained_variance_check.principal_supplier: No principal estimate is needed for this W-only finite error. A comparison with actual Dret would require an additional tail-principal cross estimate and principal-energy payment; none is supplied.

logarithmic_author_corollary_check.status: Mathematical consequence only; NOT a new Lean theorem in154LF source.
logarithmic_author_corollary_check.scope: No cap removal and no automatic transfer from a squared tail H^-2 bound to this W-only H^-1 bridge.
logarithmic_author_corollary_check.argument: Under the separate capped polylog hypotheses, Eout*moment<=C_B*x^2*L^P. Taking N=ceil(A), H=L^(P+2N), the finite2/H bridge gives2*C_B*x^2/L^(2N), then the exact RealPrecision denominator comparison gives2*C_B*x^2/Real.rpow L(2A). C_B is B-only before A and atoms. Finite bridge itself imports neither log-saving theorem.

remaining_obstacles: No upper bound for signed hybridVariance, retained-centered variance, original principal variance, CRT/Poisson nonzero part or complementary signed spectral mass.
